title: Encoding as a root-power sum
statement: Let $\ell$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $m,y$ be length-$\ell$ vectors over $\mathbb F_2$. In the quotient obtained by adjoining a root $\alpha$ of $X^\ell+\sum_{i<\ell}m_iX^i$, the encoding of $y$ is $\sum_{i<\ell} y_i\alpha^i$.
hypotheses_covered: $m$ and $y$ are length-$\ell$ vectors over $\mathbb F_2$
